access_rules.description: Ordered list of IP-based access rules (action: 'allow' or 'deny', source: CIDR or IP).

action.description: Whether to allow or deny the source.

enabled.description: Enable HTTP caching of static teletext pages.

directory_listing.description: Show file list when a directory is requested (dangerous in production).

extra_headers.description: Custom HTTP headers to add to all responses (e.g., {'X-Frame-Options': 'DENY'}).

index_page.description: Default page served when a directory is requested.

listen_address.description: IP address the daemon binds to (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces, or '127.0.0.1' for local only).

listen_port.description: Port number for incoming HTTP connections.

log_file.description: Path to log file (empty string logs to stdout).

log_level.description: Verbosity of logs: debug, info, warn, or error.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections.

mime_overrides.description: Dictionary mapping MIME types (e.g., 'text/plain') to comma-separated extensions.

burst.description: Maximum burst size (peak requests before throttling).

rps.description: Maximum requests per second per IP.

root_dir.description: Base directory containing teletext page files (e.g., .txt, .html).

use_compression.description: Enable gzip compression for text-based responses.

vhosts.description: List of virtual hosts (each with optional SSL, name, and root).

root_dir.description: Override root directory for this vhost.

cert_path.description: Path to SSL certificate file (PEM format).

key_path.description: Path to SSL private key file.
